title: Smart Irrigation System
components: Arduino Uno, Soil Moisture Sensor, 5V Relay, Water Pump
steps:
1. Connect Soil Moisture Sensor VCC to Arduino 5V, GND to GND, and AO to Pin A0.
2. Wire the 5V Relay module to digital pin 7.
3. Connect the water pump through the relay contacts to a power source.
4. Upload code to read sensor data: if below threshold, turn relay ON.

title: DIY Solar Phone Charger
components: 6V Solar Panel, 5V DC-DC Buck Converter, USB Port, Wires
steps:
1. Identify positive (+) and negative (-) terminals on the solar panel.
2. Solder wires from panel terminals to the Input side of the 5V voltage regulator.
3. Connect a USB female port to the output side of the regulator.
4. Place under sunlight and plug in your phone charging cable.

title: Home Automation via Bluetooth
components: Arduino, HC-05 Bluetooth Module, 4-Channel Relay, Smartphone App
steps:
1. Connect HC-05 TX to Arduino RX (Pin 0) and RX to TX (Pin 1) with a voltage divider.
2. Wire appliances through the 4 channels of the relay board.
3. Connect relay signal pins to digital pins 2, 3, 4, and 5.
4. Code Arduino to switch relay on serial character inputs.

title: Automatic Street Light Controller
components: LDR (Light Dependent Resistor), 555 Timer IC, LED, 10k Resistor, 9V Battery
steps:
1. Connect the LDR and a 10k resistor as a potential divider circuit.
2. Feed the midpoint voltage to the trigger pin of a 555 Timer or operational amplifier.
3. Connect an LED or a relay to the output pin to activate the light.
4. Calibrate sensitivity by adjusting the variable resistor layout.

title: Obstacle Avoiding Robot
components: Arduino Uno, L298N Motor Driver, DC Gear Motors, Chassis, Battery Pack
steps:
1. Mount the DC gear motors and wheels to the structural robot chassis frame.
2. Connect motor leads directly to the output channels of the L298N driver.
3. Route control lines from Arduino digital output channels to driver inputs.
4. Program the logic loops to orchestrate directional movement matrixes.

title: Digital Thermometer using LM35
components: Arduino Uno, Jumper Wires, Breadboard, 5V Power Supply
steps:
1. Assemble components safely on a standard breadboard circuit.
2. Interface input sensory elements with respective Arduino GPIO pins.
3. Upload custom embedded C firmware utilizing Arduino IDE configuration.
4. Power up system and verify functional parameters align with design goals.

title: LPG Gas Leakage Detector
components: Gas/Smoke Sensor Module, Active Buzzer, Arduino Uno, Red LED
steps:
1. Connect the VCC and GND pins of the sensory module to the main power lines.
2. Tie the analog or digital output pin directly to an Arduino data input channel.
3. Attach an active buzzer and warning LED to designated digital outputs.
4. Set threshold monitoring bounds inside the code script execution loop.
